shortDescription: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won will accept 700 billion won  ($523.77 million) of the 944 billion won property settlement ordered by a Seoul court in his high-profile divorce, narrowing the dispute to about 244 billion won that will now be decided by the Supreme Court, Yonhap News Agency reported on…

children: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won will accept 700 billion won  ($523.77 million) of the 944 billion won property settlement ordered by a Seoul court in his high-profile divorce, narrowing the dispute to about 244 billion won that will now be decided by the Supreme Court, Yonhap News Agency reported on Wednesday.
